avoid_supplements.name: High-dose NSAIDs (chronic use)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May counteract migraine prevention efficacy; fremanezumab works via CGRP pathway which NSAIDs partially overlap
avoid_supplements.action: Use lowest effective NSAID dose for acute migraines only; prefer acetaminophen or triptans as rescue therapy

caution_supplements.name: Ginger supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet effects; fremanezumab has no direct anticoagulant activity but combination may increase bleeding risk theoretically
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for unusual bruising; use moderate doses

caution_supplements.name: Feverfew
caution_supplements.mechanism: Traditional migraine prevention agent; additive effects with fremanezumab may increase efficacy but also side effects
caution_supplements.action: Coordinate with prescriber; monitor for adverse effects

caution_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented products)
caution_foods.mechanism: Tyramine can trigger migraines in susceptible individuals; fremanezumab efficacy may be reduced if dietary triggers persist
caution_foods.action: Identify and avoid personal migraine triggers; maintain migraine diary

monitoring_notes: Fremanezumab is a monoclonal antibody with minimal hepatic metabolism; drug-supplement interactions are unlikely at the pharmacokinetic level. Monitor for injection site reactions and ensure adequate migraine trigger avoidance during CGRP therapy.
